summary: Deep Combat Sinister Strike on the synthetic Phase 1 swords with Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Hack and Slash and Cold Blood. It is the sword alternative to Combat Daggers.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Adrenaline Rush under 39 energy while Slice and Dice is up
Blade Flurry on cooldown while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 5 combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6 s left); spend leftover points in the last 3 s
Sinister Strike right after a main-hand swing (0.5 s), or at 79+ energy
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Best Alliance race is Human (+2% crit with swords)
Swords keep 5-point Eviscerates; 4 points lose 6 to 8
Murder fixed in edd0ff72d to not raise crit damage (-13 to -19 DPS on every build)
Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV) left out under Forever; would add +13 to +18
Grimstitch 4/5-piece bonuses not live on the synthetic gear (about +8 / +6 for Combat Daggers)
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir omitted for consistency (+8 via Dragonbreath Chili)
notes: Bundled gear round (2026-10-13): request regenerated with mksettings on the merged class heads with the same arguments and edits as before; the gear set now carries the two synthetic trinkets, and the rotation uses the on-use trinket on cooldown.
